headline: Approved unpaid consultant work for two prospective members and accepted the treasurer's report.
summary: Cat Goss and Stephanie Lee were introduced as new members, and Jay Hailey presented on Cave to Code. The community survey drew 113 responses, and the council plans more tabling and a shorter survey.
decisions: Approved unpaid consultant roles for Stephanie and Abigail until they become council members, 8-0.
Accepted the report on recruitment and the community survey, 8-0.
Set grant review meetings for Nov 5, Dec 3, and Dec 10, from 5-7.

decision_titles: Unpaid consultant roles for Stephanie and Abigail
plain_text:
Fitchburg Cultural Council 
Monthly Meeting 
Thursday, September 24, 2026 
MEETING MINUTES 
 
In attendance: Eva Kelly (Chair), Liz Murphy (Treasurer), Shara Osgood (Secretary), Mike 
Amedeo, Ricardo Barros, SarahBeth Wheeler, Julio Fuentes, Kat McLellan 
 
(view FATV recording for details of meeting) 
 
CALL TO ORDER: Eva called the meeting to order at 5:04 p.m. 
 
INTRODUCTORY COMMENTS: 
Eva spoke: Welcome, MCC Mission, Public Meeting Guidelines/FCC Announcements 
 
Public Comments: No commets 
 
NEW MEMBERS; 
Cat Goss: is a Special Ed teacher at FHS & does afterschool program at Longsjo MS. Lives in 
Fitchburg (her whole life). Interested in joining the council 
Stephanie Lee. Just moved to Fitchburg this summer. Spoke with Ricardo ‘& Dan already. 
Engineering Systems Analyst. Help with spreadsheets & process keeping. 
 
GRANTEE PRESENTATION: 
Jay Hailey: founder of Cave to Code initiative to bring STEAM-based workshops and 
educational resources to the world & Fitchburg specifically. Did event at FPL: Pokémon Design 
Lab, learning how to use Canva…  cavestocode.com 
 
TREASURER’S REPORT; 
(See recording for details) We earn interest on our funds as well. Interest gets deposited into our 
local fund $3678.84 
$7550.65 that will roll over to FY27 (except for Reveille ad & swag) 
 
Motion: Sarahbeth  - to accept treasurer’s report as stated 
2nd:  Mike 
In Favor: 8 Opposed: 0  
Passes Unanimously  
 
VOTE: GRANT REPORT: 
Dan was not in attendance. No grant report tonight.
VOTE MINUTES TO REVIEW: 
No minutes to review..   
 
RECRUITMENT: 
To get new members. Strategically seek out types of candidates (I.e. spreadsheet wizard, creative 
writer, social media, sciences/nature). Put ad in Reveille. Gotb3 candidates.1 is being vetted right 
now. 2 Stephanie - spreadsheet wizard & background in process management & organization. 3- 
need to broadcast our successes. Need a story writer.  Abigail Battles. Creative non-fiction 
writer. New to Fitchburg. Wants to join council.  We need these skills & we protect you. 
Example: you are on for those duties & not for other volunteering & tabling, etc. We still want a 
Science person & social media person. 
 
Motion: Ricardo that Communications Committee be authorized to hire (for free) Stephanie & 
Abigail as consultants, until they become council members.  
Second: Liz 
In Favor: 8 Opposed: 0 
Passes Unanimously  
 
Community Survey - record respone 113. Ricardo did deeper analysis (see fatv recording for 
details). Look for ways to reach other demographics in the community, who are not already 
involved in activities. How do we reach the under represented communities.  Julio will help with 
survey re-design. More compact. 1 page. 
 
We should do more tabling. Have a calendar of FCC events. Have council members attend as 
many events as we can, both to assess & to promote. 
 
Kat: maybe ‘ 
“Hiring” for free, a student from FSU in the media dept, graphic design focus. Train & then 
maybe join. 
 
Standard operating procedures for social media already in place. Can hand to student. 
 
Motion: Shara to accept report 
Second: Julio 
In Favor: 8. Opposed: 0 
Passes Unanimously  
 
GRANT REVIEW  MEETING DATE/TIME/S: 
Set some dates for Reviews Nov, Dec on Thursdays in 2 hour blocks:
Nov 5, 5-7 
Dec 3, 5-7 
Dec 10, 5-7 
No November monthly meeting? 
Kat will ask print services to make our grant books 
 
UPCOMING EVENTS/ANNOUNCEMENTS:. 
 
● forFri 9/25 6-9 Openest Mic @ Canvas 
● Opening night America atv250+.  7:30pm at Christ Church - Stratton Players 
●  Potential Winter Bazaar - @ City Hall - Dec 5, 2026. - Liz will update survey & a 
vendor sign-up form, Shara will do flyers/ads (fcc members are welcome to join) 
 
 
Motion:  Shara -  To adjourn 
2nd: Liz 
In Favor: 8 Opposed: 0 
Passes Unanimously 
 
Adjourn @ 5:57pm 
 
Submitted by Shara Osgood
